summary: Teams of 2-4 middle school students create and deliver a multimedia presentation proposing a redesign of an underused community space, including a description, redesign concept, target users, estimated budget, funding plan, and community impact. The presentation must convince the local parks and recreation board to approve and fund the proposal. Teams must follow copyright, fair use, and AI citation policies, and supply required forms and works cited.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes setup
No less than five (5) minutes and no more than seven (7) minutes oral presentation
No more than five (5) minutes judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at seven (7) minutes
submission_requirements: One (1) copy of the Works Cited formatted according to the Style and Reference Manual for each round of the event (preliminary and final)
BPA Release Form(s) for each round of the event (preliminary and final)
AI Usage and Documentation Form for each round of the event (preliminary and final)
what_to_bring: One single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for their presentation
competencies: Research, present findings and respond to questions
Collaborate effectively in a team environment to achieve project goals
Utilize technical skills to create presentation
Apply fundamental financial principles and analyze data to support their planning and decision-making process

rubric.criterion: Team followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Team maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
Presentation content flows adequately, and each team contestant’s role is clear and integrated into the presentation. Transitions between speakers and/or points are smooth.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges’ questions.
Setup lasted no longer than three (3) minutes and presentation lasted no less than five (5) and no more than seven (7) minutes.
At least two original team members were present during the presentation.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the team and must take place within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, teams may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this judged team event
A team will consist of two to four (2-4) contestants
Contestants may not participate in Presentation Team and Prepared Speech in the same year
Previous submissions may not be used for presentations
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines or Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
